items.summary: When the 22-year-old producer Mike Varney founded Shrapnel Records in 1980, it became the first dedicated metal label in the United States, beating Jonny Z’s Megaforce and Brian Slagel’s Metal Blade to market by two years. That’s perhaps a surprising distinction for a label with such a narrow stylistic focus. As the burgeoning thrash and death metal scenes pushed American metal to the bleeding edge of heavy music worldwide, Varney stuck to his guns.
